entities.name: Grand Duke Konstantin Konstantinovich of Russia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Grand Duke Konstantin Konstantinovich of Russia was a grandson of Emperor Nicholas I of Russia, and a poet and playwright of some renown. He wrote under the pen name "K.R.", initials of his given name and family name, Konstantin Romanov.
